name: Semada

subjectOf.text: Semada is stipulated as an autonomous, decentralized, open source protocol on the Ethereum blockchain that enables domain specific reputation verification for human task crowdsourcing.
subjectOf.abstract: Semada is an autonomous, decentralized, open-source protocol29 that enables domain specific reputation verification for human task crowdsourcing, built on the ETHEREUM blockchain.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900

subjectOf.text: The protocol lowers cost because it removes the manual verification step and the associated multiplication of micro task work that centralized systems require, letting decentralized workers capture the gains from disintermediation.
subjectOf.abstract: the Semada Protocol removes the manual verification and the associated multiplication of micro task work necessitated by centralized systems, enabling its decentralized micro task workers to profit from the disintermediation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900
scope_conditions: micro task crowdsourcing under the Semada Protocol

subjectOf.text: Reputation tokens supply a staking mechanism that incentivizes high quality work and task completion by workers, and that simultaneously lets requesters verify and track worker quality, integrity, and quantity.
subjectOf.abstract: Through the reputation tokens, the Semada Protocol provides a micro task worker reputation staking mechanism that incentivizes high quality work and task completion by workers.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900
scope_conditions: participants staking reputation tokens on the platform

subjectOf.text: Unlike its decentralized competitors, the Semada Protocol is claimed to be resistant to both Sybil attacks and Tyranny of the Majority attacks.
subjectOf.abstract: However, unlike its decentralized competitors, the Semada Protocol ensures Sybil Attack and Tyranny of the Majority attack resistance.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900
scope_conditions: comparison with existing decentralized mechanical turk protocols
